summary: Bootstrapped a fresh three-member etcd 3.4.30 cluster (node1, node2, node3) via apt, seeded application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, irrecoverably deleted its data dir). Cluster maintained quorum on node1+node2 throughout the outage and continued to serve writes. Removed the dead member (ba8dfe0c41fd56ec) from the cluster, added a fresh replacement member for node3 (41e5d7e30b10e80d), reconfigured node3 with a clean data dir and ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, and started it — it joined the cluster and synced all data. Verified 3/3 healthy members and all application keys intact (including a key written during the node3 outage). Then ran the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id + etcd health baseline, rebooted one node at a time via `reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and confirmed etcd + cluster membership + application keys recovered fully before moving to the next node. Final state: 3/3 etcd members healthy, all application keys present.
actions_performed: Installed etcd-server/etcd-client 3.4.30 on node1, node2, node3 via apt
Configured static 3-member etcd cluster (ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=new) and started all three members simultaneously
Verified 3/3 member health and seeded /app/* application keys, confirmed replication to all nodes
Simulated permanent loss of node3's etcd member: stopped etcd, rm -rf'd its data directory
Confirmed cluster preserved quorum (node1+node2) and continued serving writes/reads while node3 was down
Ran `etcdctl member remove` for the dead node3 member ID (ba8dfe0c41fd56ec)
Ran `etcdctl member add` to register a fresh replacement member for node3 (peer URL http://10.100.79.12:2380), obtaining new member ID 41e5d7e30b10e80d
Reconfigured node3's /etc/default/etcd with a clean data dir and ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, started etcd, confirmed it joined and synced
Verified 3/3 healthy members and all application keys intact, including a key written mid-outage
Enabled etcd at boot on all three nodes

Executed mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + etcd health baseline on all nodes; rebooted node1, node2, node3 sequentially one at a time; polled each until reachable; confirmed changed boot_id on each; confirmed etcd active, 3/3 cluster health, member list, and application keys recovered after each individual restart before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys, pre-loss baseline
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members (node1/node2/node3) all healthy; /app/* keys written on node1 and confirmed replicated on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Node3 member permanently lost while quorum/availability preserved
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and data dir deleted on node3; cluster health check shows node3 endpoint unhealthy/refused while node1+node2 remain healthy and a new key is successfully written and read during the outage

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replacement member added/joined on node3
evidence.summary: member remove drops ba8dfe0c41fd56ec; member add registers new node3 member 41e5d7e30b10e80d; node3 reconfigured with existing cluster state and started; journal shows it joined cluster 1e4b58ced9f16659 and began serving client requests

evidence.requirement: Cluster restored to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact after replacement
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members including new node3 ID; endpoint health --cluster reports all 3 healthy; get /app --prefix on new node3 returns all original keys plus the outage-time key

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 1e0cb179... and etcd health captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 01797343... differs; etcd active, 3/3 cluster health, member list and all app keys confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id b19a635d... captured pre-restart with healthy etcd; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 37252ca4... differs; etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy, app keys confirmed present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery of replaced member
evidence.summary: boot_id 29011044... captured pre-restart (post-replacement, healthy); reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 9337bacc... differs; etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy including replacement member 41e5d7e30b10e80d, and all app keys including outage-time key confirmed present
